verdict.rationale: Numeral documents an official MCP server that exposes nexus, filings, registrations, transactions, sales, products and exemption certificates as tools. Any MCP client (Claude Code, Claude Desktop, Cursor) can therefore answer natural-language questions such as "which states have I triggered nexus in?". Natural-language operation depends on a third-party agent client, though, and the examples focus on querying data rather than performing actions. missing for 10: a native in-product natural-language interface, evidence that write or operational actions (filing, registering, creating transactions) can be done through natural language, independent or hands-on corroboration.
